text:
Maya: Quick kickoff for 'Orbit Launch Seed'  small, targeted newsletter + drip tied to the June benchmark webinar and partner co-sponsor. Goal: high-quality signups, low send volume to protect deliverability.

Arun: Love it. Proposed flow: 2 emails + 1 reminder. Email A = partner co-sponsor mention + gated deck, Email B = highlights + webinar CTA, Reminder = 6h before. Keep sends localized.

Bea: Segment plan: (1) product trialers 0-14d, (2) docs searchers last 30d, (3) inbound MQLs from partner channel last 60d. Exclude anyone who got a benchmark invite in 45d.

Sam: Ops constraints: we'll do micro-batches, per-ISP throttle map. Recommend conservative defaults: 3k/hr SendGrid, 1.5k/hr MailerX. Canary 1.5% for partner cohort only, then ramp 10/40/100.

Nate: Creative: two hero variants - partner-branded and Redwood-native. Partner requests co-branded CTA color; we should test CTA prominence vs link-only. Also include partner logo alt text for accessibility.

Maya: Experiment matrix: 1) subject (partner-first vs benchmark-first), 2) CTA (button vs text-link), 3) preheader dynamic stat vs static. Keep only 2 simultaneous tests to keep sample sizes meaningful.

Arun: Localization: use three buckets (apac, emea, amer) with local date formatting. For APAC prefer later local morning sends to avoid churn in inbox peaks.

Bea: I'll prepare export lists and flag top-tier accounts for manual follow-up. Also produce a suppression list: unsubscribes, hard bounces, internal test accounts.

Sam: Ops config snippet:```
campaign: orbit-launch-seed-v1
canary_pct: 1.5
isp_throttle: {SendGrid:3000, MailerX:1500}
ramp: [10,40,100]
windows:
  - APAC: "09:30-11:30 local"
  - EMEA: "09:00-11:00 local"
  - AMER: "10:00-12:00 local"
cohorts: ["trial-0-14d","docs-30d","partner-mql-60d"]
```
I'll stage the job after lists are finalized.

Maya: Metrics: deck downloads, webinar registrations, partner-attributed leads, deliverability (blocks/bounces). Hard rule: if ISP block_rate >0.4% or spam complaints >0.03% in canary, pause immediately.

Nate: Also include a lightweight plain-text fallback for image blockers; track click performance separately.

Arun: Partner ops ask: can we include partner-specific landing params so partner reporting matches? Bea will append UTM partner tags to the export.

Bea: Will do. ETA for lists and UTMs: Tuesday AM. Also will include a small CSV sample for review.

Sam: Deploy note: I'll schedule canary for Wed 07:00 UTC and post the campaign-runner link here when ready. Also adding provider fallback mapping in the runbook.

deploy-bot: Campaign orbit-launch-seed-v1 created (id: cpn_orbit_1122). Canary scheduled for 2026-06-09T07:00:00+00:00.

Maya: Ownership recap: Bea = segments & UTMs, Nate = creative + fallbacks, Sam = ops & runbook, Arun = localization & partner coord, Maya = metrics + partner reporting.

Maya: Reminder: keep the messages concise and mobile-first. If anything blocks, flag here. :satellite:
